# `select.save`: Save selection

Stores the elements a selector picks as a named group on the mesh.

- Category: select
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(n) per selector term in elements of its kind
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups
- Also known as: vertex group, face map, selection set, quick select, save selection

Groups survive later edits, so ops and agents can refer to geometry by name instead of indices. Selectors combine groups, normals, materials, flags and regions (see the query docs). An empty result is an error, because it almost always means a wrong selector.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | Group name; an existing group of that name is replaced. |
| `select` | `Selector` | required | Elements to store. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"name":"front_faces","select":{"faces":{"normal":{"dir":[0,0,1],"within_deg":10}}},"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): saved group front_faces (1 faces)`
